why: Most of the commands work in this repo. `npm ci` has a lockfile to use, the workspace has a test script, the bin path exists, and `gh pr view`/`gh pr checks` are valid. The builder brief's commands also run as written. The verifier brief breaks the criterion. It sets "BIN = packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js" as plain prose, not a shell variable, then gives commands like `node BIN a.jsonl bad.jsonl b.jsonl`. Run as written, `node BIN` looks for a file called `BIN` and fails, because there is no `$BIN` assignment. The paths also clash. BIN is relative to the repository root, but a.jsonl, b.jsonl and bad.jsonl are in a temporary directory. From either directory, one of the two relative paths won't resolve. So the CLI checks in Checks 1–3 would not run as written.
